headline: Nigeria's Debt Office Offers N2 Trillion FGN Bonds Amid High Liquidity
summary: Nigeria's Debt Management Office opened auctions for N2 trillion across four Federal Government bond re-openings. The offering coincides with an estimated N3.37 trillion in banking system liquidity inflows scheduled for the week.
why: FGN bond auctions establish sovereign borrowing yields in Nigeria and guide fixed-income asset pricing across West Africa.

impacts.name: Nigeria 10-Year Bond Yield
impacts.why: The N2 trillion bond issuance amidst heavy system liquidity directly impacts sovereign yields.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A heavy N2 trillion sovereign bond auction paired with N3.37 trillion liquidity inflows influences local money market yield dynamics.
